actions.title: Inspect the primary cooling assembly
actions.description: A qualified person inspects the primary cooling fan assembly on site, following the facility procedure, and reports what was found.

actions.title: Inspect the mechanical and vibration condition
actions.description: A qualified person checks mounts, bearings and balance for the source of the vibration, following the facility procedure.

actions.title: Start approved backup cooling capacity
actions.description: If the facility procedure requires it, a person starts the approved backup cooling capacity and reports that they did so. Symbiosis does not operate equipment.

actions.title: Reduce primary load per site procedure
actions.description: If the facility procedure allows it, a person reduces the load on the primary cooling assembly and reports that they did so. Symbiosis does not operate equipment.
